requirements.title: Dictionary lookup before materializing a card
acceptance: idle, loading, success, error and retry are distinct states
selected sense/example can be materialized without losing provenance
counterexamples: partial result with no selected sense

requirements.title: Dictionary detail and card materialization
acceptance: all senses, examples, forms and source/license are readable
materialize and failure states preserve the selected sense

requirements.title: Reader table of contents navigation
acceptance: TOC opens with real chapter data
selecting a chapter closes the sheet only after navigation succeeds

requirements.title: Reader settings appearance and highlight controls
acceptance: each control has stable selector and round-trips through preferences
Release hides developer hit-testing controls while DEBUG exposes an explicit diagnostic variant

requirements.title: Reader typography preview geometry
acceptance: line-height changes preview and real EPUB monotonically
highlight geometry does not diverge silently at extreme line heights

requirements.title: Reader progress and status state
acceptance: progress is derived from real document position
loading, loaded and failure states cannot share the same stale progress

requirements.title: Reader loading and recovery
acceptance: loading does not expose stale document content
retry transitions to a real loaded document or a named error

requirements.title: Explore loading and content projection
acceptance: loading, empty, loaded and error states are distinct
catalog cards render from injected data, not hardcoded preview rows

requirements.title: Review calendar empty day
acceptance: empty day is explicit and not confused with loading
selecting a populated/empty day updates the same calendar projection
counterexamples: day with zero reviews between populated days

requirements.title: Overview metrics, calendar and forecast
acceptance: metrics/calendar/forecast share one review-clock projection
zero and partial data states remain readable without fabricated values
counterexamples: large counts and long forecast text

requirements.title: Vocabulary role/review query projection
acceptance: role facets, review facets, visible rows and CTA use explicit query layers
dictionary isolation, multi-select union, search, sort and CTA IDs are asserted in UI World

requirements.title: Review card full information hierarchy
acceptance: full answer content is mounted in a readable hierarchy
examples, explanation, collocations and graph links have independent visibility contracts

requirements.title: Review card compact/full layout regression
acceptance: natural height and scroll presentation never create a centered blank region
compact mode summarizes intentionally rather than hiding fields through greedy frame constraints
counterexamples: large text with all optional fields

requirements.title: Sync settings terminal lifecycle
acceptance: sync terminal success/error is derived from one lifecycle state
retry and dismiss do not leave stale progress or duplicate work

requirements.title: Settings information architecture and grouping
acceptance: sections group by user intent with stable navigation/accessibility labels
long content, reset and destructive actions remain discoverable without ambiguous duplicate rows
